problems.title: Incorrect shear kernel and fixed transformed domain in Lemma 4.12
problems.original_claim: Displayed plus-shear w transforms the oblique problem into the printed kernel equation on B3/4 with uniformly controlled ellipticity.
problems.location: pp35-36 Lemma4.12; p38 Theorem4.1 use; p51 main dependency
assumptions: v viscosity solution of the stated weighted operator and oblique boundary problem
problems.check: Set S=[[I,omega'/omega_n],[0,1]], det S=1. Substitution yields K_new(h)=K(Sh) and domain S^-1 B1. n2,s1/2,K=|h|^-3,omega=(1/sqrt5,2/sqrt5) gives correct/printed kernel1/2 at h=e1. omega=(sqrt3/2,1/2), x=(0,7/10) lies B3/4 but |Sx|=7/5.
problems.result: Displayed kernel and domain reduction invalid.
problems.counterevidence: Normal derivative transformation is correct. Correct kernel has delta-controlled ellipticity and local domains can be used. External Neumann theory and full replacement proof not independently verified.
problems.impact: Invalid derivation directly used in Theorem4.1 and main regularity chain; no regularity counterexample.
problems.correction: Use K(Sh), determinant1 and S^-1B1; delta-dependent balls. Only algebra/local geometry verified.

problems.title: Invalid derivation of the full regularity exponent range, with a threshold-preserving repair
problems.original_claim: Shrinking rho0 permits gamma near s and every alpha=s gamma/(s+gamma)<s/2.
problems.location: pp38-41 adjustable estimate and tail closure; pp42-43 fixed iteration; p45 final reciprocal/radius sentence
problems.check: Error gives gamma=s log2/log(1/rho0), matching p42/p43 2=rho0^(-gamma/s). p45 prints reciprocal2=rho0^(-s/gamma). Decreasing rho0 decreases gamma/alpha. At s1/2, rho1/4 gives gamma1/4 alpha1/6; rho1/16 gives gamma1/8 alpha1/10.
problems.result: The printed final sentence is invalid, but the full advertised alpha<s/2 range is supported by the earlier estimates after the explicit fixed-parameter and graph-gradient argument.
problems.counterevidence: For each alpha<s/2 choose alpha<q<gamma_lin<s. Fix rho with (c0/2)rho^(gamma_lin-q)<=1 and C(rho^(gamma_lin-q)+rho^(s-q))<=delta0, then choose epsilon0. With theta=rho^q both new flatness and defect tails close. Iteration gives a uniform O(r^(1+q)) boundary strip; the existing local graph and its uniform affine remainder yield gradient C^q by a three-remainder finite-difference estimate. To retain the initial epsilon threshold independently of alpha, first use the fixed-contraction iteration on p42 until bar_epsilon*2^(-k) is below the target-specific threshold; the corresponding defect tails are bounded by delta0 times this flatness, uniformly on a fixed smaller set of centers. Then rotate and switch to the strengthened iteration. No exponent-uniform external boundary estimate is certified.
problems.impact: Major proof issue: the final argument fails to establish a central quantified exponent range. A conditional repair from preceding estimates does not downgrade the invalid derivation. No counterexample to the regularity theorem is claimed.
problems.correction: Replace the final radius sentence by the fixed alpha,q,gamma_lin,rho,theta selection, tail closure, and uniform graph-gradient argument explicitly given in the report and analysis. Include the finite coarse-iteration entry step before switching contraction, so no new alpha-dependent initial hypothesis is imposed.

assumptions: Omega upper halfspace, smooth boundary through0
u=sqrt((x2)+), U0=1 and finite weighted tail
interior harmonicity independently checked by one-dimensional PV integral

problems.result: Explicit admissible counterexample to printed exterior sign.

problems.correction: Insert minus in exterior leading terms; immediate sign conflict repaired, full variational constants not independently reconstructed.

problems.title: Missing symmetric term in min-max identity and typographical logarithmic sum
problems.original_claim: Equation(5.8) gives a pointwise identity with only one crossing orientation and the following symmetric energy identity has coefficient2.
problems.location: p54 equation(5.8) and its integrated form; p53 annular-sum explanation
assumptions: arbitrary real w1,w2,phi1,phi2 in the pointwise algebra
symmetric kernel and symmetric ordered-pair domain for the integrated identity
the stated logarithmic cutoff with2k comparable tolog2R and theta^(2k)=R
problems.check: Set w1=0,phi1=1,w2=1,phi2=0: left side0, printed right side2. Case separation gives correction -2(a_+b_-+a_-b_+), a=w1-phi1,b=w2-phi2. Symmetric integration produces coefficient4. Annular sum equals1+k theta^2=O(logR).
problems.result: Printed pointwise and integrated identities have the stated local errors.
problems.counterevidence: Corrected energy cross term is nonnegative and its factor is absorbed into unspecified C in Lemma5.8; (logR)^-2 timesO(logR) gives the desired inverse logarithm.
problems.impact: Local algebraic/typographical corrections; no counterexample to the classification theorem.
problems.correction: Include both crossing orientations; use coefficient4 after symmetric integration and orderlogR for the annular sum.

checks.derivation: For W=F composed with S and det S=1, direct y=Sz substitution gives K(Sh) and domain S^-1 B1. The printed inverse shear and |omega_n|/|omega'| factor fail at h=e1 for omega=(1,2)/sqrt5 (1 versus 2). At omega=(sqrt3/2,1/2), x=(0,0.7), |Sx|=1.4 exceeds the original domain. The oblique derivative does transform correctly and delta-controlled local balls repair the immediate geometry.
checks.assessment: Major invalid reduction directly used by Theorem 4.1, Theorem 1.5 and the main theorem; no false-regularity counterexample claimed.

checks.derivation: At r_k=rho0^k/2, error 2^(-ks) gives gamma=s log2/log(1/rho0). Decreasing rho0 lowers gamma and s gamma/(s+gamma). Hence the final printed argument does not establish the central all-alpha<s/2 range. For alpha<q<gamma_lin<s, choosing fixed small rho with positive-power contraction/tail inequalities is valid. Before that stronger iteration, p42 supplies uniform bar_epsilon*2^-k flatness and delta0 times that tail at a fixed smaller set of centers, so finitely many coarse scales enter each target-specific threshold. Uniform strip errors imply the affine remainders and C^q gradient by three-remainder subtraction.
checks.assessment: Major central derivation defect despite a conditional repair. The repair now preserves the alpha-independent initial hypothesis, and does not assert exponent-uniform external boundary estimates.

checks.derivation: For n=2,s=1/2,K=|h|^-3,u=sqrt((x2)+), tangential integration gives 2/(a+t)^2 and the exterior operator -4 integral sqrt(t)/(a+t)^2=-2 pi a^-1/2. Interior PV contributions 1 and -1 cancel. The profile is admissible with finite weighted tail. Later variational sign agrees with the corrected negative exterior operator.
checks.assessment: Minor local sign defect; Bernoulli normalization not refuted.

checks.derivation: With a=w1-phi1,b=w2-phi2, the missing correction is -2(a_+b_-+a_-b_+). At (w1,phi1,w2,phi2)=(0,1,1,0), the printed sides are 0 and 2. Symmetric integration doubles the stated crossing coefficient; the unspecified C absorbs it. The annular sum is O(log R), which combines with log^-2 R to give the claimed log^-1 R.
checks.assessment: Minor local algebra/typographical issue; classification conclusion not disproved.
